preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (deployer)
Attacker must hold some MSA tokens to demonstrate the exploit
swapAndLiquifyEnabled should be true (default is false, but owner can enable it)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, first enable swapAndLiquifyEnabled via setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(true). Then set _taxFee and _liquidityFee to high values (e.g., 49 each) using setTaxFeePercent(49) and setLiquidityFeePercent(49). Transfer MSA tokens to another address (non-excluded from fees) to trigger the high fee mechanism. The contract will accumulate fees and eventually swap them for BNB, which can be drained to the marketing address (controlled by owner). Alternatively, set marketingAddress to attacker's address first via setMarketingAddress().
